import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Top-left: Revenue by product category (bar chart)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax1.bar(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values)
ax1.set_title('Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01,
             f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top-middle: Sales distribution by time of day (heatmap)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
time_product_sales = df.pivot_table(index='hour', columns='product', values='total', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
im = ax2.imshow(time_product_sales, aspect='auto', cmap='YlOrRd')
ax2.set_title('Sales Heatmap: Time vs Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(time_product_sales.columns)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(time_product_sales.columns, rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax2, label='Revenue ($)')

# 3. Top-right: Revenue by age group and takeaway status (grouped bar)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
age_takeaway = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack()
age_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, width=0.8)
ax3.set_title('Revenue by Age Group & Takeaway Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax3.legend(['Dine-in (0)', 'Takeaway (1)'], title='Takeaway')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 4. Bottom-left: Payment method distribution (pie chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
payment_dist = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(payment_dist.values, labels=payment_dist.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette('Set2'))
ax4.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Bottom-middle: Price distribution by size (box plot)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='size', y='price', ax=ax5, order=['Small', 'Medium', 'Large'])
ax5.set_title('Price Distribution by Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Price ($)', fontsize=12)

# 6. Bottom-right: Daily revenue trend (line chart)
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
daily_revenue = df.resample('D', on='datetime')['total'].sum()
ax6.plot(daily_revenue.index, daily_revenue.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=4)
ax6.set_title('Daily Revenue Trend', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Daily Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
